services.name: Spa package
services.desc: A different kind of day spa, built around private beer spa suites, modern relaxation, and Colorado’s craft beverage culture. We combine two incredible things, beer and relaxation, to give you an unforgettable spa experience packed with wellness benefits. Oakwell combines private spa suites, a self-pour taproom, and a Relaxation Lounge into one experience. Whether you’re visiting solo, as a couple, or with a group, our packages can help you choose the perfect experience. Every Oakwell spa package includes 90 minutes in a private spa suite with a warm herbal bath, infrared sauna, and rain shower.
